scanned.description: Rows read over the FULL corpus (dedup/secret tier).

sampled.description: True when the statistical tiers ran over a sample.

sample_size.description: Rows in the statistical sample; None when the full corpus was scanned.

ner_skipped.description: True when the guard early-exit skipped the NER pass (format already catastrophic); full-corpus secrets were still scanned.

quarantined_rows.description: Malformed source lines routed to quarantine instead of crashing (#1008).

format_detected.description: Winning format from the full-corpus vote.

format_conformant_pct.description: Sampled conformance to the detected format.

dedup_exact.description: Rows that are exact duplicates of an earlier row.

secret_rows.description: Rows carrying a leaked secret over the FULL corpus; None when off.

findings_path.description: The full findings payload (scan_findings.json), for the control-side hoist.
